author: Porkyyy
body:
I have been playing Control The Hill for some time now, and I've noticed that many people use kit "shadow" and kit "ninja" to go invisible and then they take their boots off.

This is extremely annoying, and is not fair in my opinion. I am simply wondering if this is a glitch, and is not supposed to happen? If this is how it is meant to be, then I request that it is removed.

People abuse these kits very much, and it is not a fair way to gain XP.
They hide in the middle and collect points loosely while other players have to fight their way into the middle and they actually earn those points.

Thank you, and please consider this.
